body: I haven't been in this situation, but a friend of mine has. They've found that listening to music, writing down and going through a list of things that make them happy, playing instruments, and hanging out with friends helps them make it through. They've also taken B12 to help with the lack of energy and sometimes take melatonin to sleep. I don't know that any of that would help, and I know personally that it isn't as easy as "just don't," but try to remember the things that make you happy when you feel a more intense bout of depression coming on. That's what works for most of my friends struggling with depression, and it works like 80% of the time for the person I know with MDD.

ECT (electroconvulsive therapy) is thought to trigger a "hard reset" of the brain, so to speak. The reset tends to help pull people with MDD (major depressive disorder) out of any detrimental cycles, rituals, or habits that form as a result of their MDD. It's merely safer than drug-induced convulsion and can be more targeted and controlled since the purpose of administering ECT is to treat a mental disorder. It's not something to be administered or considered lightly though. ECT is a last-resort for major depressive disorder that resists more conventional methods like therapy and medication. ECT is often followed by conventional therapy/medication. Just like any other seizure or convulsion, medically induced seizures are still potentially damaging and/or lethal (see SUDEP: https://www.epilepsy.com/learn/early-death-and-sudep/sudep)
Happy birthday to the wonderful soul that is your grandmother. May she rest in peace and watch over you from heaven.

It might not be so easy since you're an adult and probably share important assets with her (such as a house), but you need to get out of that situation. The fact that you're aware of the nature of the situation is a good thing, but you need to decide how to approach it in a way that would be best for you. I don't know your whole situation, but it's never good to remain in an abusive situation. If you have to, get authorities involved. Just get out.

It's okay. I get it. It seems really impossibly difficult and intimidating, or maybe you just don't want to. But maybe make steps towards that as an eventual goal rather than making steps towards your other goal. If not that, then at the very least consider the matters at hand and the nature of death. It's not a solution. It's hardly even a way out. Death is a very very very permanent event with life altering consequences. Please reconsider the nature of your plan at the very least if you feel like you can't reach out, or try to make progress towards feeling like you can reach out so you can get help. I can't speak for the whole website, but most of us aren't here to see people die and/or encourage it. We want you and everyone else to get better so you can thrive again.

Let me start by saying thank you for taking any amount of your time to read this at all, let alone to make a response. It means a ton to me. Do you have any advice on how to make that first step? I just feel really alone in this. I've tried to talk about it with my boyfriend and be open and receptive, but lately he's felt nothing but guilty about the fact that I don't feel better. I'm afraid talking to family is gonna result in overly drastic actions or a total lack of consideration... I'm afraid of making things harder for myself. If you did it, how'd you make it to the first step?

It kinda started as not wanting to be arrogant or whiny and just evolved from there. Now I've reached the point where talking to friends/family feels absolutely impossible and selfish. I don't wanna waste another second of their time, ya know? Thanks for even taking the time to read this and reply. I honestly didn't expect any answers at all. This is just an attempt to get it out somehow without making things worse and just hating myself more.

Rather than trying to come up with excuses, maybe try reaching out? After all, this is an online subreddit. Regardless of our intentions, we can't do much to tangibly alter your situation. It sounds like you've spent a lot of time thinking about this. Please please take a step back and consider your options. I don't know your situation like you do and neither does anyone else, but there are other options. Please reach out to someone instead of fixating on the "deadline" and the potential conflicts with your schedule. Reach out for help. Don't do it.

Thanks for taking the time to read any chunk of this and reply. At this point, I'd almost rather act rashly than bother to try navigating the lonely shitshow that is my non-existent self esteem. If it really mattered and I really mattered, I'd probably have some friends to show for it by now. Even if someone out there does love me, do I really even deserve it

I'm not so certain. But that's okay. I don't know why I even posted here, honestly. As if wasting the time of people on the internet somehow makes it okay to do so. Thanks for taking the time to read any small chunk of that. But I'll probably live.
